root_idea.summary: The root has two established semantic axes: the number seven and the predatory wild animal.
root_idea.development: The numerical branch extends to being seventh, a seventh part, seven-based measures and periods, and completion by adding to a specified number. The animal branch extends to prey-taking, attack, predation, and figurative descriptions of harmful or uncontrolled conduct.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The feminine numeral form سَبْعَةٌ is the gendered counterpart of the same cardinal numeral.
The temporal tag at 69:7 does not establish a separate lexical item; it is the same numeral in a grammatical time expression.

senses.definition: Seven; the cardinal number seven, including its gendered form سَبْعَةٌ and the seven-based form سَبْعُونَ, seventy.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in counted expressions and with units, persons, periods, celestial structures, and other counted entities. The form varies according to the grammatical gender and construction of the counted noun.

senses.definition: A large or indefinite number, conventionally expressed as seventy or many times.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially attested in the Quranic expression سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً, where “seventy times” is explained as “many times,” not as a limit that would become effective only after seventy.

senses.definition: The “seven oft-repeated,” a Quranic designation for the Fātiḥah, or, in another explanation, for the group of long surahs.
senses.usage_conditions: The referent of السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي is explained in more than one way: as the seven-verse opening surah, or as a group of long Quranic chapters.

senses.definition: A predatory animal or beast of prey, especially one that attacks and seizes animals or people.
senses.usage_conditions: The term generally denotes a fang-bearing, hostile predator such as a lion, wolf, lynx, leopard, or similar animal; the Quranic occurrence is definite: السَّبُعُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become the seventh; to make a group seven, or to complete a group by adding oneself as the seventh member.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same completion pattern is extended to other totals, such as making sixty-nine become seventy or sixteen become seventeen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a seventh part of someone's property or possessions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a distributive or share-taking use, distinct from merely being seventh in a group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a rope or cord of seven strands.
Of an infant, to undergo the seventh-day shaving and sacrificial rite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specifically reported birth custom associated with the seventh day after birth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seize, kill, and eat animals as prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a wolf or other predator attacking sheep or goats; the passive construction describes an animal whose young have been eaten by a predator.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To steal something, treating it as prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the predator's seizure of its prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shoot at, strike, or frighten someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of attacking or frightening a wolf, and also of attacking a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To revile, vilify, insult, or assail someone with offensive language; to backbite.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative comparison is with the hostile or biting conduct of a beast of prey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bite someone with the teeth, like a beast of prey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A directly physical usage reported alongside the figurative use for verbal abuse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something seven or call it seven; to complete a number to a seven-based total.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The completion use can be extended to totals such as seven hundred; a reported usage for making an amount seventy is marked as post-classical and nonstandard in the source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something have seven angles or corners; to make it heptagonal.
To give a reward sevenfold or multiply something many times over.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The number may be used for an exact sevenfold increase or more generally for multiplication beyond seven.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause one thing to follow another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in relation to either beneficial or harmful consequences.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bless someone with seven children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A benedictory formula wishing or attributing seven offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To wash or rinse a vessel seven times.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The seven repetitions are part of the reported conventional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange the recitation of the Quran in seven portions so that it is completed every seven nights.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Quran-recitation scheduling expression, not a Quran occurrence of the derived verb itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain with one's wife for seven nights.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional temporal construction involving seven consecutive nights.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to give birth after seven months of pregnancy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported usage specifically describing a seven-month birth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal-noun usage of the Form III derivative.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Competing with another in obscene or lewd speech and in the frequency of sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized conventional usage associated with forbidden conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mutual reviling or vilification between two people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal use describes each party assailing the other with offensive language.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a group, to become seven or seventy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive numerical use distinct from the Form I and Form II causative or completion uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a man or his camels, to follow a seven-day watering cycle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camels come to water on the seventh day, counting according to the reported traditional reckoning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to give birth to her seventh offspring.
Of a road or locality, to abound in predatory animals; of herders, to have their livestock attacked by predators.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes either an environment containing predators or the resulting predation on livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feed someone the flesh of a predatory animal, or to give someone as food to a predator.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source reports both possible interpretations of the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give or deliver a child to a nurse or nurses.
To leave someone unattended, without work, occupation, or restraint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of leaving a slave to himself and allowing him to remain daring or uncontrolled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place to which mankind will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized interpretation of the expression يوم السبع.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An occasion of trials or danger when a flock is left without a shepherd and exposed to predators.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative interpretation of يوم السبع in which the predator is portrayed as the flock's only guardian.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A festival in the pre-Islamic period on which people were diverted from other concerns by games and entertainment.
A seventh part; one part of seven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural أَسْبَاعٌ is also used for the seven divisions into which the Quran may be arranged for recitation; that latter expression is reported as post-classical.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A traditional seven-day watering interval for camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported reckoning counts the interval between successive visits to the water according to a specified pastoral convention.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seventh young one or offspring.
The constellation Lupus, situated behind or east of Centaurus.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or transferred astronomical name, distinct from the animal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weight relation in which ten units weigh seven mithqals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression وَزْنَ سَبْعَةٍ for a specified monetary or weight standard.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great, momentous, or difficult affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the idiom إِحْدَى مِنْ سَبْعٍ, the number evokes a notably difficult or severe matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seven or more; several or many.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported vague use in which the numeral is not intended as an exact count.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lioness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form also appears in a comparison for a forceful or impetuous seizure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A forceful seizure or harsh punishment, expressed through the idiom of taking someone like a lioness or like the legendary Sebʿah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression has competing explanations: a lioness, a very strong or audacious man named Sebʿah, or the force of seven men.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Predatory; belonging or relating to an animal of prey.
Seventieth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An ordinal use of the seventy-based numeral.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Apparently, one accustomed to frightening others or something frightening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical interpretation is reported tentatively in the source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment or piece of cloth seven cubits or spans in length.
A great, tall camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The description is connected with a seven-span measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Complete or full-grown in body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a person who has reached the physical development associated with seven spans.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seventh; the one that occupies seventh place or makes six become seven.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same ordinal enters compound forms such as seventeenth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, coming to water on the seventh day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a plural description of camels following the traditional seven-day watering cycle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period of seven days; a week.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may also be used in plural expressions for multiple weeks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The seventh day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In customary expressions it may mean the seventh day after marriage, childbirth, or another specified event.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Seven circuits around the Kaaba.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A ritual count of seven circumambulations, also used for the corresponding plural circuit-units.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Given or delivered to a nurse; especially a child suckled by someone other than its mother after her death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The nursing and maternal-loss interpretations are reported as related applications of the adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Left to himself, without occupation or restraint, and consequently daring or harmful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a slave or person allowed to become like a predatory animal in mischievousness; a near synonym is مُهْمَلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of suspect, bastard, servile, or otherwise ignoble lineage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported lineage extends in different authorities to several male or female ancestors, including up to seven.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Born after seven months of pregnancy, before full gestation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A term for an incompletely matured infant whose gestational months were not completed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel-owner, having camels that come to water on the seventh day.
A shepherd whose flock has been attacked by a predatory animal.
Land containing or abounding in predatory animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a fixed feminine place-description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A verse consisting of seven metrical feet.
A camel having seven redundant vertebrae in the middle part of its back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical description of the camel's back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rope consisting of seven strands.
A cow or other female wild animal whose offspring has been eaten by a predator.
A place inhabited by or associated with a predatory animal.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Its reported completion-to-seventy usage is explicitly covered as a post-classical, nonstandard extension under the broader completion meaning.
Illustrates the cardinal numeral in a poetic expression.
Compound numeral pronunciation and grammatical behavior only.
The entry records that the proposed usage is unattested.
Compound ordinal use is covered by the ordinal meaning.

cautions: The public numeral headword groups the QAC forms سَبْعٌ, سَبْعَةٌ, and the tagged occurrence at 69:7; the differences are grammatical or constructional rather than separate lexical roots.
In السَّبْعُ الْمَثَانِي, the classical explanations differ as to whether the expression denotes the Fātiḥah or a group of long surahs.
